owner: CC (code + proofs). Akien owns the SHAPE — specifically whether an unmatched line is a refusal or a stamped measurement, because a ruling he speaks away from the terminal has no transcript to match and must not become unrecordable.
watchme: none, because the thing this ticket builds IS the standing check. A watch guards a property that could drift back after a build proves out; here the build's whole output is a measurement that runs at every intake, so a watch beside it would be the same question asked twice. The one drift a watch COULD catch — the host moving or renaming the transcript, silently turning every line into 'unmatched' — belongs to the instrument's own falsifier clause (2), not to a second mechanism: an unmatched line is loud by design.
intention: `cairn ruling open` measures, at intake, whether each line of `the_ruling_verbatim` occurs byte-identically among the human messages of the session transcript, and records what it found.
why: THE FIELD EVERY OTHER FIELD IS CHECKED AGAINST IS ITSELF UNCHECKED. The door refuses `the_ruling_verbatim` empty, refuses non-string entries, and DERIVES confirmation from a `RULED` marker found inside it — three mechanisms that all trust the field's content, and the content is typed by CC. The lived symptom, measured at n=1 on 2026-08-14 and not hypothetical: the packet for 2026-08-14-tools-and-machines-remember-under-their-holder passed every shape refusal, passed `verify` green, and got auto-confirmed — while its first verbatim line was a TIDIED version of what Akien wrote. A clause of his quote had been elided to '...', his paragraph breaks collapsed into single spaces, and a full stop added that he never typed: 631 characters where he had written 738. Nothing in the system could see it. Akien saw it, by pasting his own terminal log back and making CC compare. A reading checked against a paraphrase of his words is a reading checked against CC, which is the exact circularity edge (f) was built to end — reopened one layer down.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. 'these are his words' is today an unmeasured claim carrying a confirmation.
Law 4 — a rule enforced by physics, not policy. 'quote him exactly' is discipline, and discipline is what this component keeps proving it cannot rely on.
Law 7 — permanent in records of truth. A decision record IS a record of truth; a tidied quote inside one is an error that got collapsed into a coherent shape.
Law 10 — nothing in the system is immeasurable. The session transcript is JSON on disk and greppable, so 'we have not built the measurement yet' is the true state here and the only acceptable one.
ruling 2026-08-13-tools-have-users-not-owners and every ruling since — all of them rest on this field.
gates: The instrument: parse the session JSONL, collect the human-authored messages (both `type:"user"` string content and `attachment.queued_command` entries whose `origin.kind` is `human` — mid-turn interjections arrive as the latter and are NOT user-role turns, which is itself a thing the first attempt got wrong), and test each verbatim line for byte-identical membership. Proven by a tooth that TIDIES a known-good line — elide a clause, collapse a newline — and requires the check to catch it. A hollow build passes by substring-matching the raw escaped JSON text, which reports False on a line that IS his because of `\n` and `\uXXXX` escaping; the proof must parse, never grep.
falsifier: RED if: (1) a tidied line is reported as matched; (2) an exact line is reported as unmatched because the reader grepped raw bytes instead of parsing records; (3) a mid-turn interjection ('SO RULED' arriving beside a tool result) is reported unmatched because the reader only looked at user-role turns; (4) an unmatched line silently BLOCKS a ruling Akien spoke away from the terminal — the failure mode that would make him stop recording rulings, which is worse than the defect.
horizon: Next time anyone is inside cairn/machines/ruling. NOT urgent-in-anger: every ruling in the store today reads correctly, and the one corrupted line is repaired. It IS load-bearing, because the store now holds 45 rulings whose authority rests entirely on this field and the number only grows.
dependencies: MEASURED 2026-08-14, so the size is not a guess. The reader is ~15 lines and needs no new dependency: `json` and `pathlib`, over ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl. The seam into the door is one call inside `open_ruling` beside `ruled_marks`.

THE ONE REAL UNKNOWN, and it is why this is THINKME rather than BUILDME: the door does not know which session it is running in. The transcript path has to be found (newest JSONL for this project, or an env var the host sets), and 'newest' is a guess that will be wrong the first time two sessions run at once.
distinctions_recorded: MEASUREMENT, NOT REFUSAL, is the shape CC would propose and it is Akien's to settle. An unmatched line has three innocent causes — he ruled in person, he ruled in another session, the transcript rotated — and a refusal turns all three into 'you cannot record that ruling'. A stamped field the hook can report keeps the fact loud (Law 7) without building a door that punishes him for not being at the terminal.

THIS IS NOT edge (h). Edge (h) says his words matching CC's READING of them (`now_the_spec_says`) is not derived and never was. This ticket is one layer beneath: whether his words are HIS WORDS. Both were unmeasured; only one was ever written down.
provenance: Born 2026-08-14, inside the conversation that ruled tools-and-machines-remember-under-their-holder. The same packet had already been refused three times by the door — a dict where a list of his lines belonged, self-authored confirmation fields, and conformers measured against the wrong baseline — all three caught by physics. The fourth defect was the one no physics existed for, and Akien caught it by hand. That ordering is the whole argument for this ticket.

chart_notes.orient: The transcript is at ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl and the door does not know which session it is in — that unknown is why this rests at THINKME rather than BUILDME. Two shapes of human message live in there and BOTH count: `type:"user"` records with string content, and `attachment.queued_command` records whose `origin.kind` is "human". Mid-turn interjections — "SO RULED" arriving beside a tool result — are ONLY the second kind, so a reader that walks user-role turns alone will call his ruling a fabrication.
chart_notes.constrain: The bound is Akien's and is not CC's to assume: an unmatched line must not become an unrecordable ruling. He rules in person, in other sessions, after a rotation. CC's proposal is a door-stamped MEASUREMENT the hook can report, never a refusal — but that is a proposal, and the shape is his to settle before BUILDME.
chart_notes.validate: The tooth that a hollow build fails: take a line known to be his, TIDY it the way CC did — elide a clause to '...', collapse a paragraph break to a space — and require the check to catch it. The second tooth is the inverse and it already bit once: substring-matching the RAW jsonl text reports False on a line that IS his, because the file stores \n and \uXXXX escaped. Parse records; never grep bytes.

filed_edges: The same gap exists for every other store that quotes him — tickets, slates, troubles, notes. This ticket deliberately scopes to `cairn ruling`, because that is where a quote CARRIES AUTHORITY: the confirmation is derived from the words. Elsewhere a tidied quote is an error; here it is a forged signature. If the check proves out, the other stores are a follow-on and not this build.
